notable_absence.finding: Unlike createcollection.md (WITH clause gated to 'Couchbase Server 7.6 and later'), this page contains no server-version citation at all - CREATE SCOPE has no WITH clause and no version-gated behavior described. A clean instance of the anomaly simply not appearing, on a structurally near-identical statement.

cross_component_finding: The Prerequisites table (credential type -> privilege) is worded identically to createcollection.json's and dropcollection.json's, confirming Scope Admin (Advanced) / Write (Basic) is the shared privilege pair for the whole scope-and-collection DDL family, distinct from the index-statement family's Query Index (Advanced) / Write (Basic) pair.
